name: Pokequizz
summary:
Pokequizz is a fan-made collection of daily Pokémon quiz games. Across nineteen games, the player identifies a Pokémon, a move, an ability or an item from partial clues such as types, base stats, a Pokédex entry, a silhouette or a competitive moveset, with content covering the nine generations of the main series.

Other modes change the format: a 3 x 3 grid in which each cell must match the criteria of its row and column, chains of Pokémon joined by a shared trait, and a hidden type to deduce by attacking Pokémon. Players can also face each other in ranked duels and private rooms, climb leaderboards and collect mascot avatars, some of them in a shiny version.
